newBoundary: Full modular covariance does not force orientation loss; it forces the seam into a line with character or a vector-valued/metaplectic carrier.
chi5 is not an ordinary bosonic partition function by itself.
A non-chiral absolute square cancels the character but also removes the sign information.
The weight-five character line is not a scalar factor of the weight-twelve Leech degree-two theta series.
A physical bridge must derive a fermionic/Pfaffian or defect sector and its coupling to Leech pair data.
